purpose: Prove the two driver-local campaign tools for the TB2.1 multi-GPU speed run (docs/46) end-to-end against mocks, with zero GPU use: tools/tb21_shard.py (timeout-budget bin-packer) and tools/tb21_campaign.sh (pass runner). Every number below names the command that produced it; every run happened on the IN1 driver VM (jl-vm-473296, ubuntu@151.185.34.98) or this repo checkout.

tools_delivered.tools/tb21_shard.py: greedy-makespan bin-packer: 89 tasks -> K shards by declared agent_timeout_sec from receipts/terminal-bench-2.1-task-inventory.json; emits shard-<i>.txt lists + manifest.json with per-shard budget sums and max/min balance ratio; deterministic (sort ties by name, load ties by shard index); --only for subsets
tools_delivered.tools/tb21_campaign.sh: driver-local VPC/docker pass runner: gate/ladder wrappers (LadderGate's tb21_gate.py/tb21_ladder.py, --base-url injected), shard, pass1 (K parallel harbor jobs pinned shard->replica), resume, merge (one pass receipt via tools/tb_rows.py), metrics-snap (immutable verbatim snapshots), disk-guard (15G floor, alexgshaw-only removal, orphan sweep). tools/run_terminal_bench.sh (AIBoss/tunnel/podman variant) untouched, as required by the in-flight owner-protocol passes.

harbor_subsetting_verified.command: ssh ubuntu@151.185.34.98 'export PATH=$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH; harbor --version && harbor run --help'
harbor_subsetting_verified.mechanism: -i / --include-task-name <str>: 'Task name to include from dataset (supports glob patterns)', repeatable -- pass1 passes one -i per task from the shard file. Task-dir subsetting is unnecessary.
harbor_subsetting_verified.resume_shape: harbor job resume -p <job-dir> [-f <error-type> ...] -y (verified via harbor job resume --help on the driver)

shard_packing_measured.skew_bound_note: build-pov-ray alone declares 12000s; no packing can split a task, so K8's 1.0328 is close to the floor.
shard_packing_measured.determinism: second K4 run to a different outdir: all four shard-<i>.txt byte-identical (cmp), manifests identical modulo generated_utc/argv (python dict equality). Required because harbor refuses to resume a job whose config (the baked -i set) changed.

mock_proof.where: driver VM (CPU-only; no GPU exists there -- the no-GPU constraint holds by construction)
mock_proof.endpoint_double: tools/tb_mock_endpoint.py, two independent instances (shard affinity preserved end to end)

clean_pass.command: TB21_TIER=mock TB21_N=1 TB21_SHARD_DIR=$HOME/tb21/shards/mock2 tools/tb21_campaign.sh pass1 hyd 2 http://127.0.0.1:18091 http://127.0.0.1:18092
clean_pass.shards: packed by the real tool: tb21_shard.py --shards 2 --only {adaptive-rejection-sampler, regex-log, sparql-university, openssl-selfsigned-cert, dna-assembly} -> shard-0 {dna-assembly, regex-log} 2700s, shard-1 {adaptive-rejection-sampler, openssl-selfsigned-cert, sparql-university} 2700s, ratio 1.0000
clean_pass.result: shard-0 ran exactly its 2 tasks against :18091 (2/2 trials, 1m14s), shard-1 exactly its 3 against :18092 (3/3, 1m44s); both harbor jobs exited 0; -i subsetting confirmed live, not just in --help

kill_and_resume.setup: fresh tier mockr; shard-0's mock set to --turns 100000 so its first trial never completes; shard-1's to --turns 6
kill_and_resume.kill: kill -9 -- -369804 (SIGKILL of shard-0's whole setsid process group) while its agent was mid-transcript (mock log: 'call #35: 69 messages, 23804 prompt chars')
observed: sibling shard-1 finished all 3 trials and exited 0, unaffected
parent pass1 reported: '[tb21c-mockr-hyd-p1-s0] exited 137 -- resume with: tools/tb21_campaign.sh resume tb21c-mockr-hyd-p1-s0'

the killed trial's task container leaked exactly as the pins document (dna-assembly__x99swga__env-main-1 Up 9 minutes) while shard-1's container was live beside it -- which is why resume never runs the orphan sweep
kill_and_resume.resume: tools/tb21_campaign.sh resume tb21c-mockr-hyd-p1-s0 (with the shard-0 mock restarted at --turns 2 on the SAME port, since the job config bakes api_base) -> harbor deleted the in-flight trial dir and re-ran; job completed 2/2 trials in 3m37s

idempotent_resume_of_finished_job.method: sha256 over 'find . -type f | LC_ALL=C sort | xargs sha256sum | sha256sum' on tb21c-mockr-hyd-p1-s1 before and after resuming the already-finished job (3.85s, kept 3 trials)
idempotent_resume_of_finished_job.delta_isolated: per-file diff across a second resume: ONLY job-root config.json, lock.json, result.json change (timestamps/lock ids regenerate on every resume); every TRIAL directory is byte-identical. Refines the pins' 'finished job 4/4 byte-identical' claim: the scored evidence is byte-stable, the job-root metadata is not.

merge.receipt_shape_verified: per_shard rows (n_trials/resolved/started/finished/wall_s per job), aggregate (n_tasks 5, headline '0/5 resolved', wall_clock_s = min started_at -> max finished_at across shards, exception histogram, agent_timeout_errors), rows via tools/tb_rows.py (5 rows, task set exact), attribution stub one entry per unresolved task with classification/bf16_rerun_resolved/bf16_rerun_job/notes ALL null for pass 3 to fill
merge.expected_zero_note: 0/5 is correct: the mock returns valid Terminus-2 turns but does not solve tasks; the verifier scoring 0 everywhere is the proof the whole verify path ran

disk_guard.orphan_sweep: [orphans] reclaimed 1 container(s), 1 compose network(s) left by an interrupted pass -- the SIGKILL leak from the resume test, gone; sweep is skipped whenever a harbor process is live, and resume never invokes the guard at all
disk_guard.floor_policy: below 15G: docker.io/alexgshaw/* images only, images with a running container skipped, never a global prune (pins disk_hazard policy, verbatim)

metrics_snap.success: [metrics] ~/tb21/metrics/mock-pre.prom: 2 lines, sha256 fa6d8041f95b727a12b3e706724c2a9a0659058852f864c40d49f320e4b0925e (verbatim body confirmed by cat)
metrics_snap.immutability: second snap with the same tag refused: 'snapshots are immutable (delta discipline) -- pick a new tag'

mock_proof.gate_ladder_wrappers: missing-file path errors cleanly ('tb21_gate.py not staged next to this script'); with LadderGate's tools staged, 'gate <url> --help' and 'ladder <url> --help' reach both argparse surfaces through the injected --base-url (LadderGate's canonical contract: flags only, --base-url + --out)

named_deviations_and_notes: model_info.max_input_tokens defaults to TB21_MAXLEN=262144 (docs/46 native-window recipe), a named deviation from the pins' 32768 which was correct for the 32k-window owner-protocol run; override with TB21_MAXLEN when serving a different window
retry classes and 15G disk policy are verbatim from receipts/terminal-bench-2.1-pins.json (transport-only; AgentTimeoutError deliberately excluded)
job names are tb21c-<tier>-<model>-p1-s<i> (one harbor job per shard); the docs/46 name tb21c-<tier>-<model>-<pass> maps to the MERGED receipt, since a K-shard pass is K harbor jobs by design
